about_short_description.short_description: Flash is a mobile application and financial service company that facilitates digital payments to businesses.

product.name: Flash Mobile Payment Platform
product.description: A mobile payment application for managing payment methods, tracking transactions, and making digital payments to participating merchants and service providers.

product.name: Flash for Business
product.description: A merchant payment service that enables businesses and local brands to collect digital payments from customers through Flash.

product.name: Bill Payments
product.description: A digital payment service for paying bills such as utilities, school fees, and donations through the Flash application.

product.name: QR Code Payments
product.description: A mobile payment service that lets users pay participating merchants by scanning transaction QR codes in the Flash application.

product.name: NFC Utility Top-Up Facilitation
product.description: A facilitation service for topping up utility cards through NFC, with processing provided by third-party service operators.
